style: STRICT 2D PIXEL CHIBI, cozy office game top-down three-quarter orthographic camera. Head >= one third of full height, target 40 percent; expressive highlighted visor eyes. Dark warm plum-charcoal selective one-pixel outline, warm readable limited palette, 3-4 hard-edged tones per material. Deliberate chunky square pixel clusters at logical 32x64 scale, no smooth/vector curves, gradients, glow bloom, antialiasing or dithering. Full body target about 26x46 logical pixels; antenna included. Keep eyes big enough to survive 32x64 extraction (each 3x4 pixels including highlight). Pure uniform magenta #FF00FF background, no magenta in subject. No scenery, floor, shadows, furniture, punctuation, text or grid. IDENTITY LOCK: Friendly boxy little robot office intern, clearly mechanical not a human in armor. Oversized rounded-square orange head, about 40 percent of full body height, one short centered antenna with a cream round tip. ONE continuous dark navy horizontal visor band with two LARGE expressive cyan rounded rectangular eye-light shapes INSIDE it, each eye has a bright cream-white square catchlight in its upper corner and a darker cyan lower edge; never dots or a blank strip. Tiny friendly pixel smile below the visor. Burnt-orange and apricot boxy torso panels, cream shoulder caps, dark charcoal joint gaps, short stubby orange forearms with cream mitten-like grippers, short charcoal legs and broad orange block feet. Tiny warm teal scarf wrapped at neck with ONE short tail on anatomical left, no other clothing or badges. Back of head has a simple orange inset panel and two dark vent slots; no face or visor on back. Strong square-head/antenna silhouette, squat compact rectangular body; keep panel shapes, scarf size, antenna and visor identical in all views.
